description: Original faction-specific civic diplomat portraits matching the shipped painted unit atlases. Replaces the original flat UI portraits; faction names and procedural battle models are unchanged.

portraits.name: Senator
portraits.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: one square game unit portrait tile for Peris. Create ONE original Roman Senator civic diplomat matching the art of ONE CELL of the supplied Roman unit atlas, not a sheet. The reference is STYLE ONLY: same highly detailed hand-painted fantasy strategy-game rendering, realistic anatomy and tactile materials, warm upper-left key light, crisp readable silhouette, dark olive vignette background, thin aged-gold rounded square frame. Character: mature Roman-inspired human statesman, short greying curls, dignified stern face, ivory wool toga with broad deep crimson stripe, antique gold fibula, holds a rolled parchment charter with a crimson wax seal across the lower torso. No military helmet, weapon or shield. Composition: waist-up three-quarter pose, full head visible, face near upper center; body and hands fill the lower part. Frame inset roughly 6 percent from the square edges, dark olive background only INSIDE frame; genuinely transparent outside frame. Match reference portrait framing and character scale closely so this belongs beside Legionary and Eagle Guard at 48px. Not a flat vector icon, not a modern cartoon, not a giant head avatar, no labels, writing, text, lettering, logo or watermark. One single square tile only; do not reproduce the nine-cell atlas.
